runs: Where shocks can arrive faster than a staged switch, the successor must be prepared and rehearsed before it is needed. That readiness has a standing cost, and the cost belongs in the decision. Emergency measures carry fixed expiry, independent renewal and review afterwards.

A ranking, benchmark, forecast or diagnosis can change the behavior it measures. Tag each deployed measure R0 (negligible feedback), R1 (bounded or slow) or R2 (consequential), with reasons. For each, ask who uses it, what decisions follow, what behavior changes and what becomes invisible.
Ask also when it is taken. A measure on a known schedule invites preparation for the schedule rather than for the outcome (§4, D2).
